graph.name: Launchmetrics: How Launchmetrics Produces Fashion Luxury and Beauty Data Insights for 1B Users
graph.notes:
Processing 8M posts, 70M comments, and other data about fashion products and get insights out.
    EC2 Spot Instances why? Mostly to cut costs since EC2 costs are about 75% of the total cost.
    Kinesis and SQS allow resumption of operation if something (on the EC2s) terminates in between.
    Plan to move EC2 instances to containers using ECS.
